resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the tower is not used; the Forest Rangers list counts it among still-standing towers, with no date. Both can be true, and neither says what stands at the site today.

notes_for_editor: Name and place match in two sources (Canada Lookouts and Forest Rangers #39, Mid-Northern Ontario). The LIO point (OGF_ID 70699531, Old Fire Tower, Verified, within 100 m) matches the record's coordinates. The Forest Rangers list is an undated private page, so its 'still standing' heading is weak evidence. Ontario records carry no local_unit, so the story says only 'near Gogama'. No build year, height, staffing or fate in any source read. Consider renaming the record's id slug (it says unnamed) since two sources give the name Chester; no correction is proposed.
